# Joseph

- **Gender:** male (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Relationships P57](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0057)</sub>

- **Family:** [Barbara Shaw](../character/barbara-shaw.md) (relative)

## Appearance

Joseph is a calico animal featuring a distinctive coat of many colors. His physical markings include white legs spotted with black, a gray back bearing a large yellow patch on one side and a black patch on the other, and a yellow tail with a gray tip.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P56](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0056), [v3 ch.Relationships P57](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0057), [v3 ch.Interlude P18](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0018)_

## Personality

Joseph is a naturally meek and inoffensive individual. He possesses a friendly and sociable disposition.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P57](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0057)_

## History

Joseph is a cat who was given his name because of his multicolored coat, having previously belonged to a dear friend of [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md). He moved into Patty's Place along with [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) and the [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md) when she arrived to chaperone [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends. After initially engaging in repeated battles with Anne's stray cat, [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), Joseph eventually formed a close friendship with him.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 ch.Relationships P2](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0002), [v3 ch.Relationships P44](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0044), [v3 ch.Relationships P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), [v3 ch.Relationships P55](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0055), [v3 ch.Relationships P56](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0056), +3 more_

### [Rusty](../character/rusty.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/joseph--rusty.md)

Joseph and [Rusty](../character/rusty.md) are cats living together at Patty's Place who transformed from bitter rivals into devoted friends. Upon Rusty's arrival, the two engaged in repeated battles for position in the household. Over time, their dynamic changed completely, and they became sworn friends who peacefully slept on the same cushion.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 ch.Relationships P2](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0002), [v3 ch.Relationships P44](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0044), +4 more_
